description: GitHub Actions workflow that publishes to GitHub Pages
agents: Deploy: GitHub Pages. `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` runs `npm run check` (build + validation) and publishes `dist/public` on every push to `main` (or by hand from the Actions tab). In the repository settings set Pages → Source to "GitHub Actions". `relativeUrls: true` in `config/default.ts` writes every link relative to its page, so the site works both at `<user>.github.io/<repository>/` and on a custom domain; keep writing links as `/about/` and `/assets/…`. URLs built in JavaScript are not rewritten.
